rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance
rules_evaluated.evidence: No banned words found in body (honest, delve, landscape, importantly, crucial, substrate, leverage, synergize, paradigm shift)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban
rules_evaluated.evidence: No ritual/ceremony/practice-as-noun in body; loop appears as concept, not ceremony

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no 'fixed' retrospectives, no session biography
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 2026- dates, 'caught live', 'compounded', 'historically', 'used to' in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match — AE101 voice quintet
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 5 Godin warmth, line 9 Boris flatness, line 13 Sutherland reframe, line 17 Martin frame, line 27 quintet closure. Voices selected deliberately per sentence job.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body is a lecture, not article rough-cut draft format

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique
rules_evaluated.evidence: Dinner demo cited in backing block as demo-fires-live (Agents 101 prior, maintainer-attested). No external technique paraphrased without credit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always 'you', never 'the student'; teacher framing stays out
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 5 'You've already done' (×3 instances), line 11 implicit-you imperative, line 17 'You, in a way', line 19 'You told it', line 27 'You become'. Zero 'the student', 'the trainer', 'the creator'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body
rules_evaluated.evidence: Loop earned at line 23 header + defined at line 26-27. No self-compound, substrate, three-pattern, grill-me in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector — no reassurance shapes
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 13 'But not as reliably' hedges Finnish example, documented in backing as maintainer-attested. No 'it's OK if', 'no penalty', 'not a downgrade'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body contains no reference artifacts with 'Frame to land' sections

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module
rules_evaluated.evidence: Zero practitioners credited in body prose. Zero mentions = passes the cap at one.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 21 'The move is loading...not a clever prompt' has punchy negation scoped to M1 (maintainer: 'No plan mode on this surface'). Claim holds, not false.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'not an aspirational', 'not a vendor', 'grounded in actual', 'unlike consultancy', 'real practitioners'. Body teaches mechanism and practice, not positioning.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early
rules_evaluated.evidence: Loop earned at line 23/26-27. Prompt earned via examples. Context earned via demo. No term available only downstream.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not an edit trimming forcing function from body into prompt

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The `What happened:` block is OPTIONAL
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture, not an exercise. Rule 16 applies to exercise bodies only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose
rules_evaluated.evidence: Verbs for Claude/agent: answers, suggests, shifts. All peer-flat or warm. Zero bark, order, command, force, drag, push, boss.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 3 'Who this is for' — literally true. Line 7 'Context is King' — metaphor backed by truth (context conditions output). Line 15 'You steer the answer' — literally true. Line 23 'The loop is what you repeat' — literally true.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without content
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negation, deictic drumroll, bold-label echo, or citation duplication. Each sentence does work.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds
rules_evaluated.evidence: No numbered lists preceded by count-statement. Line 25 lists three actions without pre-count.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 27 'You become the Claude wizard BY running the loop' claims method, not guarantee. Scoped to 'running the loop on real work' and 'letting the habit sharpen'. Claim holds.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule fires on cross-file claims in 2+ bodies. This is single-file evaluation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale in sweep
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is single-file evaluation, not a multi-file sweep

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap
rules_evaluated.evidence: Opens with 'You've already done the hard part' (validation), closes 'You become the Claude wizard' (aspirational). No 'you already think', 'you're missing', 'you lack'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use
rules_evaluated.evidence: Claude Code pre-earned (line 5). Context taught via examples, defined line 17. Loop introduced line 23, defined line 26-27. Prompt shown via italicized quotes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No narrating student's past or present state
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 5 'You've already done the hard part' = peer recognition of chosen effort, not patronizing narration. Not 'You're building' or 'You're getting comfortable'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body doesn't discuss memory vs context distinction; uses both words naturally with correct meaning

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No scheduling the student's attention
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body contains no consumption-guidance lines or 'come back for'/'read later' scheduling

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body is narrative teaching, not prompt-design prose. Does not specify output shape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always 'you', never 'the student'; teacher framing stays out
rules_evaluated.evidence: Zero 'the student', 'the trainer', 'teacher', 'facilitator', 'say to room'. All student references direct 'you'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body
rules_evaluated.evidence: Loop earned; no substrate, three-pattern, grill-me, self-compound, send-off, gate, check, steering in maintainer-only context

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Overclaim of student verification or coverage
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body does not ask for verification or audit of artifacts

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is not a simulation; no personas involved

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No 'What research says' callout boxes
rules_evaluated.evidence: No callout boxes present in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'open terminal', 'git commit', 'edit file', 'save to disk'. Implied moves ('Take a guess', 'notice') stay cognitive.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body prose does not reference CLAUDE.md or any configuration layer

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No em-dashes or — in body. All sentences under 30 words or cleanly split.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Not em-dashes again — this is checking a different surface
rules_evaluated.evidence: Applies to all student-facing curriculum; no em-dashes present

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture headers are declarative per carve-out (lectures default declarative; exercises default command verbs). This is M1 opener lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename
rules_evaluated.evidence: No inline links present in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives
rules_evaluated.evidence: Loop = curriculum-coined, defined in file. Context = plain meaning (what you tell agent), not Claude Code memory paths. Both clear from examples.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Claude answers/suggests' = product/UI reference (appropriate for chat interface). No agency framing error. Body uses Claude for product ref, not agent autonomy.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'tomorrow', 'overnight', 'this morning', 'tonight', 'next morning', 'yesterday', 'last night' in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reflection headers or contemplative-pause prefixes present ('Pause', 'Meta-moment', 'Sit with', 'Take a moment')

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body is narrative lecture, not exercise with Claude prompts or meta-ask patterns

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: .md is default file type for student artifacts
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body contains no instructions to save files

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every sentence moves toward understanding context-as-steering. Italy→Finland→cardiologist example progression. Reframe lands. Practice named. Zero NVA asides.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body 'read it' / 'look at it' after chat-print = dead weight
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'Read it', 'Look at it', 'Study', 'Notice'. Italicized examples stand alone; next sentence moves forward with meaning.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 27 closes on 'You become the Claude wizard' (student subject). Not training/curriculum as subject or different-role addressing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body is narrative lecture, not instruction with operational settings (model choice, mode, path, tool shortcuts)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym
rules_evaluated.evidence: Loop (house term) used and defined, not substituted. Steering one natural form. Context grounded in examples. House vocab from curriculum spine, not invented per-sentence.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body does not direct saving to artifacts or ask for named actions on files

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics
rules_evaluated.evidence: No terminal commands, browser flows, or setup recipes in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'A later module...', 'The first move outside repo...', 'you'll see in M2...'. Body teaches concept (context, loop), not arc position.
